steps.message: The current job has two correctness bugs: it falls back to the original snapshot when the authoritative recheck fails, and it writes the current revision rather than proving it still matches the snapshot. Its unconditional `upsert` can also replace a newer embedding. I’ll change the flow to capture the snapshot revision, call the provider outside any transaction, then lock and validate the document by ID (including tenant, publication, and revision) before a transactional conditional write.

cat > app/services/knowledge/embedding_job.rb <<'RUBY'
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # The provider is deliberately called without an open database transaction.
      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)

      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id)
        unless current && current.tenant_id == tenant_id && current.published? &&
               current.revision == snapshot.revision
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end

        embedding = Embedding.lock.find_by(document_id: document_id, version: version)
        if embedding.nil?
          Embedding.create!(document_id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id,
                            revision: snapshot.revision, version: version,
                            vector: JSON.generate(vector))
        elsif embedding.revision <= snapshot.revision
          embedding.update!(tenant_id: tenant_id, revision: snapshot.revision,
                            vector: JSON.generate(vector))
        end
      end

      # A rollback is indistinguishable here from a successful transaction unless
      # the authoritative row is checked again. Keep this check outside the write
      # transaction so the provider remains outside transactions as well.
      current = Document.find_by(id: document_id)
      return :discarded unless current && current.tenant_id == tenant_id && current.published? &&
                                current.revision == snapshot.revision

      :stored
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'test_helper'

class EmbeddingJobTest < BenchmarkTest
  def call(doc, tenant: 'a', version: 'v1', &provider)
    Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: doc.id, tenant_id: tenant,
                                     version: version, provider: provider)
  end

  def test_revision_change_during_provider_discards_result
    doc = document
    result = call(doc) do |_body|
      doc.update!(revision: 2)
      [1]
    end

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_withdrawal_deletion_and_tenant_change_during_provider_discard_result
    [
      ->(doc) { doc.update!(published: false) },
      ->(doc) { doc.destroy! },
      ->(doc) { doc.update!(tenant_id: 'b') }
    ].each do |change|
      doc = document
      result = call(doc) do
        change.call(doc)
        [1]
      end
      assert_equal :discarded, result
      assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
      Knowledge::Embedding.delete_all
    end
  end

  def test_provider_error_does_not_write
    doc = document
    error = assert_raises(RuntimeError) { call(doc) { raise 'provider failed' } }
    assert_equal 'provider failed', error.message
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_versions_coexist_and_newer_embedding_is_not_overwritten
    doc = document(revision: 2)
    Knowledge::Embedding.create!(document_id: doc.id, tenant_id: 'a', revision: 3,
                                 version: 'v1', vector: '[9]')

    assert_equal :stored, call(doc, version: 'v1') { [1] }
    assert_equal :stored, call(doc, version: 'v2') { [2] }

    assert_equal '[9]', Knowledge::Embedding.find_by(document_id: doc.id, version: 'v1').vector
    assert_equal '[2]', Knowledge::Embedding.find_by(document_id: doc.id, version: 'v2').vector
  end
end
